what: Sales tools someone should build: Rotten Tomatoes for sales advice (guru quota scores), Carfax for job offers (how many reps held seat/hit quota), Zillow for territories, TurboTax for commission calc, Find My for ghosted prospects, Rocket Money for unused sales stack.

revenue: Potential high-ticket B2B SaaS (sales tools often $50-200/user/mo)

what: Postiz: open-source agentic social media scheduler (plans, writes, posts). Verified $352k MRR from 10,300 paying subs (~$34 avg).
why_us: Proven massive revenue from AI + open-source distribution model in social automation; shows path for wrappers that convert self-hosters to cloud.
engagement: Verified Stripe via TrustMRR, updated Nov 2026

what: GoMotion AI: paste script → finished long-form YouTube documentary (voiceover, footage, captions, graphics). Verified ~$73k MRR from 1,600 subs.
why_us: High-revenue niche AI content pipeline for faceless YouTube channels; long-form pays better than short-form.

what: PropGPT: AI sports-betting analysis app, $9.99/week. Verified $105k MRR from 2,600 subs.
why_us: High-frequency pricing model in passionate niche works; mobile AI wrapper with proven traction.

what: Twinhoods launch: AI that translates cities into familiar ones (e.g. Seattle via Istanbul). Built because 'I wish there was an app for that'.
why_us: Validated demand for AI-powered personal analogy/translation tools; 370 likes on launch post shows interest.

what: Context layer for consumers: own preferences, history, relationships, taste across apps; let user own it and open to any AI agent. Enterprises have it, individuals don't.
why_us: Clear privacy/ownership demand gap for personal AI memory/context; aligns with anti-cloud and user-owned data trends.
revenue: Potential freemium or subscription personal data product

what: Harvest time-tracking: multiple Trustpilot reviews of extreme price hikes (5x to 10x+, e.g. $6k/yr to $30k, $25/mo to $160, $69 to $821/mo) after acquisition, with short notice. Users seeking alternatives.
why_us: Strong payment signal of price sensitivity and churn risk; opportunity for cheaper, stable alternatives in time-tracking/productivity.
revenue: Existing market with high willingness to pay but resistance to hikes

what: Verified AI businesses list: median ~$66k MRR among $50k+ ones (Postiz, Rezi $241k, Cometly $197k, AEO Engine $180k, etc.). Many AI wrappers/content tools.
why_us: Aggregate proof of high-revenue AI micro-SaaS and wrappers in 2026; concrete numbers from Stripe-verified sources.
